Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:97435: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)
Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of Service via unsafe requeue in rxrpc_recvmsg (CVE-2026-23066)

* kernel: Kernel: Race condition in espintcp can lead to denial of service (CVE-2026-23239)

* kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of service due to a race condition in the TLS subsystem (CVE-2026-23240)

* kernel: net: ipv6: fix NOREF dst use in seg6 and rpl lwtunnels (CVE-2026-46099)

* kernel: ext4: fix e4b bitmap inconsistency reports (CVE-2026-45942)

* kernel: ppp: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in target netns for unattached ioctls (CVE-2026-53075)

* kernel: Revert "wireguard: device: enable threaded NAPI" (CVE-2026-52945)

* kernel: pNFS: Fix use-after-free in pnfs_update_layout() (CVE-2026-63800)

* kernel: net: shaper: rework the VALID marking (again) (CVE-2026-64027)

* kernel: xfrm: route MIGRATE notifications to caller's netns (CVE-2026-63914)

* kernel: net: hsr: fix potential OOB access in supervision frame handling (CVE-2026-64000)

* kernel: af_unix: Fix UAF read of tail->len in unix_stream_data_wait() (CVE-2026-64109)

* kernel: bpf: Reject fragmented frames in devmap (CVE-2026-64355)

* kernel: i2c: core: fix adapter deregistration race (CVE-2026-64279)

* kernel: proc: protect ptrace_may_access() with exec_update_lock (FD links) (CVE-2026-64375)

* kernel: Linux kernel: PPP over L2TP Use-After-Free vulnerability (CVE-2026-68398)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: reject mapping a reserved doorbell to a new queue (CVE-2026-68103)

* kernel: mei: bus: access mei_device under device_lock on cleanup (CVE-2026-68181)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix responder UAF on IB_QP_MAX_DEST_RD_ATOMIC modify_qp (CVE-2026-80864)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix OOB in free_rd_atomic_resources() (CVE-2026-80863)
